dealbreakers: Factual error in the time-difference table, in the row for my own case (seven hours apart): ['Four to eight hours', 'Your evening is their night, or their morning', 'Breakfast for one, dinner for the other; ...']. At a 4-8 hour gap your evening is never their morning. 8pm for you is 1-3am for someone 5-7 hours ahead, or 12-4pm for someone behind. Breakfast-for-dinner only works at roughly 10-14 hours. If I followed this I'd book an 8am breakfast date that falls at 1am or 3am for my partner.
